questions.text: Which of the following protocol pairs can be used to send and retrieve e-mails (in that order)?
questions.solution:
SMTP is used to send (push) mail. POP3 (or IMAP) is used to retrieve mail from the mailbox. MIME is only a format for attachments.

Answer: SMTP, POP3

questions.text:
Consider the following given grammar: 
 
S -> Aa
A -> BD
B -> b| ε
D -> d| ε
Let a, b, d and $ be indexed as follows:

Compute the FOLLOW set of the non-terminal B and write the index values for the symbols in the FOLLOW set in the descending order. (For example, if the FOLLOW set is {a, b, d, $}, then the answer should be 3210).
Answer:_____
questions.solution:
A [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] BD, so B is followed by D: FOLLOW(B) gets FIRST(D) [latex]-[/latex] {[latex]\epsilon[/latex]} = {d}.
D can be [latex]\epsilon[/latex], so FOLLOW(B) also gets FOLLOW(A) = {a} (from S [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] Aa).

FOLLOW(B) = {a, d}. Indices: a = 3, d = 1 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] in descending order: 31.

Answer: 31

questions.text: An array of 25 distinct elements is to be sorted using quicksort. Assume that the pivot element is chosen uniformly at random. The probability that the pivot element gets placed in the worst possible location in the first round of partitioning (rounded off to 2 decimal places) is _________.
questions.solution:
The worst position for the pivot is either end of the array, which happens when the pivot is the smallest or the largest element: 2 out of 25 choices.

[latex]P=\frac{2}{25}=0.08[/latex]

Answer: 0.08
